subject: Re: Follow-up: Data handling requirements & training-on-customer-data opt-out
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@acmefin.com>, Legal Ops <legal@acmefin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Data handling requirements & training-on-customer-data opt-out

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we all have a single source of truth:

1) Data handling summary: Acme wants assurances on PII handling, logs retention, and that customer content will not be used to improve models unless explicitly allowed.
2) Training-on-customer-data: You asked for an explicit opt-out so Acme's production traffic and content are never used for Redwood model improvement.
3) Data residency & logging: Preferred residency = us-east; retention window requested = 90 days for request/response logs (audit logs longer if needed).
4) Security artifacts: attaching our SOC 2 summary and high-level data flow diagram for the infra we discussed.

Action items:
- Sam: Please confirm that opt-out is desired for all environments (prod/staging) and the requested retention/residency.
- Legal Ops: If you can share the DPA/contract language or redlines we can route to our contracts team; if you prefer we can generate a standard addendum that includes the opt-out and retention terms.
- Rishi / Marissa (internal): I will open a ticket to flip the training-opt-out flag on the account once we get confirmation and route for signatures. Also will confirm how logs are exported/trimmed to meet the 90-day request.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sam Torres <s.torres@acmefin.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@acmefin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Data handling requirements & training-on-customer-data opt-out

Neha — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming the following from Acme: 

- We would like to opt-out of training-on-customer-data for all environments (production and staging). This must be a contractual guarantee.
- Data residency: US-East (we use AWS us-east-1).
- Retention: 90 days for full request/response logs; we will need immutable audit logs retained for 3 years for compliance (read-only access).

Legal is attaching our initial DPA amendment request for the opt-out language and retention commitments (Acme_DPA_Request.pdf). Please have your legal/contracts team review and provide your standard addendum or redlines.

Also please confirm operationally how the opt-out is enforced (a per-account flag? per-route?) and whether there is any impact to feature-level telemetry.

Thanks,
Sam Torres
Sr. Product Security Lead | Acme Financial
s.torres@acmefin.com | +1 (617) 555-0987

Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Data handling requirements & training-on-customer-data opt-out

Sam — thanks, this is clear and totally doable. A couple quick operational notes: 

- Enforcement: We support a per-account training_opt_out flag which prevents any customer content from being routed into our model improvement pipelines. We can apply it at the tenant level and also support route-level overrides if you need.
- Retention: We can set application request/response logs to 90 days; audit logs can be exported to a secure S3 bucket or retained in our audit store for the 3-year window you requested (we'll provide read-only access controls).
- Contracting: I've looped in Legal/Contracts internally. We can provide a short addendum that mirrors your language; alternatively we can accept your redlines — whichever you prefer.

Next steps: 
1) Neha: will route Acme_DPA_Request.pdf to Contracts and ask for redlines/addendum.
2) Rishi: can you prepare the internal change (ticket + deployment window) so we can flip the opt-out once legal executes?
3) Marissa: please prepare the operational runbook for residency/retention export and confirm estimated completion date.

I'll also prepare the order form and DocuSign link so Legal can sign the addendum and order. Attaching provisional order form: Docusign-ACME-Order-Form.pdf
